# Meter

The progress bar.

`LL.Meter` · Components · Data

## Use

```jsx
<LL.Meter value={0} max={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="LL.Meter" value="{{0}}" max="{{0}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Shows "value / max" in tabular figures and reserves the width of "max / max", so a live value never shifts the row. The fill is scaled, never resized; under reduced motion it moves at once.
